mutations.event_text: {name} absorbs enough tower residue to reform as a {target_species}.
{name} hardens around the tower's strange rhythm and reforms as a {target_species}.
{name}'s feathers dim into luminous dust as she reforms into a {target_species}, ready for archive work.
{name} has run the same passages often enough that she has stopped running them. She comes back up longer, slower, and certain of the way, a {target_species} now.
The load {name} has carried up out of the tower stops being something she carries. She sets nothing down and stands like a {target_species}, because that is what she is.
{name} finishes the guild's ledger, closes it, and begins a different one in a hand nobody taught her. The tower has a {target_species} again, and the guild has lost an archivist.
The stone {name} wears stops being armour some time in the night. In the morning she is sitting on the stair counting, a {target_species}, and she will not say what the count is for.
{name} has been answered by the tower too many times to keep only asking. She replies to something in the dark, at length, and comes back a {target_species}.
